result.title: Response-Informed Value Estimation for Cost-Aware Multi-Turn LLM Routing
result.summary: Multi-turn LLM routing selects a model at every turn before its response is available, yet task success is revealed only when the interaction ends, leaving each intermediate choice without a label of its own. Logged trajectories, however, retain the response each call produced, which exposes what each turn required and how well the chosen model served it, evidence that outcomes alone hide. We introduce RIVET (Response-Informed Value Estimation for Turn-Level Routing), which exploits this post-call evidence during training while keeping routing strictly pre-call at deployment. RIVET jointly trains two value estimators over a shared state-model representation: a deployable Routing Value Estimator that scores candidate models from pre-call information, and a training-only Response-Informed Value Estimator that additionally observes the realized response. Conditioning on the response turns response-induced return variation from residual noise into an observed covariate, and we show that this reduces the leading asymptotic estimation error of the shared representation. On the MINT benchmark, RIVET solves more held-out tasks than the strongest multi-turn baseline while using 74.7% less total call cost.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 RIVET：在多轮 LLM 路由中联合训练两个共享状态表示的价值估计器，其中一个仅在训练时额外观察已实现回复，把回复带来的回报波动转为可观测协变量，部署时仍只用调用前信息；在 MINT 上以更低总调用成本解决更多任务。
AI.relevance_reason: 训练期引入仅训练可用的「特权」信号做回合级信用分配、并与可用估计器共享表示，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的贡献分配与监督设计提供借鉴；其逐回合模型选择也具算力分配含义，与 THINK/LOOK/STOP 决策结构可供核查。
